name: @sekiban/dcb-cloudflare
description: Optional Cloudflare composition helper. Mounts Sekiban storage beside the caller's own Worker. Not an application and not part of the matched set.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/compose.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/compose.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --external:@sekiban/dcb-runtime --external:@sekiban/dcb-runtime/cloudflare --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/cli.js
